title: Tsubaki-chou Lonely Planet
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High school second-year Fumi Oono takes a live-in housekeeping job with gruff novelist Akatsuki Kibikino to pay off her father's debts. Cooking, cleaning and sharing a house, the two slowly soften toward each other, and Fumi falls for her much older employer. A shojo romance from Shueisha's Margaret.
life_message: A good life is built by hard, honest work and by caring for people until a cold house becomes a home.

content.note: Teen girl's romance with her adult employer (AniList Age Gap tag, rank 85); cohabitation; intimacy level to verify. MangaDex safe.
